blocks.content: You've accomplished something major—you built a fully playable game with working mechanics.
But right now, your game starts immediately when the page loads and never ends. That's not how real games work! Real games have:

items: A start screen where you press "Play"
An end screen showing your final score

blocks.content: This chapter is all about adding game flow—the structure that makes your game feel complete and professional.
By the end of this chapter, you'll have:

items: Three screens that switch between each other
A countdown timer that ends the game
A proper game loop (start → play → end → restart)

blocks.content: Let's start by creating the three screens your game needs!
